M-Cn: I'm calling from Data Trend Enterprises. We have a client flying in from Shanghai tomorrow morning and would like a driver from your chauffeur service to pick her up from the airport. W-Am: I can arrange that for you. May I have her name, flight number, and arrival time? M-Cn: Her name is Tina Ming, and she'll be arriving on flight DF304 at 10:20 AM. Also, could she be taken to the Palm Hotel before being brought to our office? She'll need to drop off her luggage. W-Am: No problem. I'll add the pickup to our schedule and one of our employees will be at the airport in the morning to get her.

W-Am: Hello, my name is Leslie Carver from Danis Incorporated. My department will be having a luncheon on July 2nd at noon. I'd like you to deliver food and drinks to the eighth floor conference room for approximately 50 people on that day. M-Cn: Okay, Miss Carver, do you expect any attendees with special dietary requirements? W-Am: Yes, actually. I noticed on your online menu that you have vegetarian sandwiches. So could I please order 10 of those? For the remaining sandwiches, I think a combination of the chicken salad and roast beef ones would work. Also, do you offer drinks without any sugar?

M-Cn: Good afternoon. My name is Frank Peters and I have my yearly physical examination today with Dr. Murray. My appointment is at 10:45 a.m. W-Am: Hello, Mr. Peters. Please wait while I pull up your records. Also, did you by chance bring your health insurance card today? If so, please place it on the counter. M-Cn: Yes, I have it right here. But may I ask what you need it for? Isn't my insurance information already on file? W-Am: All the state hospitals recently adopted a new record sharing system that will keep patients like you from having to register personal information at each facility. I just want to confirm that your medical records are in order following the upgrade.

M-Cn: Good morning, Miss Willard. This is Hiro Kusunagi from Decor Max. I visited your booth at the Virginia Crafts Exhibition and I was impressed with the wooden picture frames you make. Would you be willing to sell them at my store on a commission basis? W-Am: I'd be very interested, Mr. Kusunagi. Why don't I bring some samples to your store later this week? M-Cn: Great. We can talk about prices and other details then as well. Um, how many frames can you produce each month? W-Am: About 40, but I could make more if I hired a couple of assistants for my workshop. M-Cn: That probably won't be necessary right away, but we can talk more about that when we meet.

W-Am: Alonzo, are you done creating the blueprints for the Morrissey building? Our supervisor wants to review them in our meeting at 4 p.m. M-Au: Not yet. I'm still working on the presentation slideshow for the seminar I'm leading tomorrow on finding architectural inspiration. It's been taking me longer than anticipated. W-Am: Hmm, I gave a similar presentation to new hires last year. How about I finish the slideshow so that you can focus on the blueprints? M-Au: I'll email you the presentation materials in a minute. Let me just wrap up the design for this slide and save the file to my computer. I really appreciate your assistance.

M-Cn: Yumi and Brian, will Hall A in our museum have enough room for the Egyptian art exhibition? W-Am: Maybe. There aren't many pieces to display, right? M-Cn: Just two dozen, but they're all large, so we need a big space. I recommend Hall C instead. Is it available? W-Am: It will be. Korean tapestries are there now, but our director said to take them down on August 1st. W-Am: Um, I'm a little worried since that only gives us three days to set up the necessary pieces. M-Cn: How about printing the labels for the Egyptian works beforehand? Then we could just move everything into the hall prior to the event. W-Am: Okay. I'll grab the artwork list for us to reference now.

M-Cn: Good afternoon. This is Carlos Tran and I'm a representative from the Riverside Business Institute. I was hoping to reach Miss Brenda Ling in regard to the advanced accounting course she completed last week. W-Br: This is Miss Ling. What can I do for you? M-Cn: I'm contacting the participants who went through the course to gather feedback. The responses we receive will help our organization to improve its services and curriculum in the future. Could you spare a moment to answer some questions? It won't take up much of your time. W-Br: I'm actually quite busy at the moment. I'll have some free time in the afternoon, however. Please call me back after 2 p.m.

W-Am: Hi there. It's my first time selling my fruits and vegetables at this farmer's market. I noticed that your booth is popular. How do you attract so many customers? M-Cn: I upload pictures of my products online. My blog gets a lot of visitors, and many of them decide to stop by my stall. How about trying something similar? W-Am: That's a great idea. Thanks for the advice. Also, do you know if vendors can get a discount at other sellers' stands? M-Cn: I'm not sure. You should ask the market's organizer about that. Oh, there he is now, talking to the owner of Diana's Juice Bar. W-Am: Okay, I'll do that right now.

M-Cn: Hi, my name is Cody Tate and I'm calling from the Bryant Park Activity Center. I'd like to talk to you about the neighborhood event you volunteered to work at tomorrow. W-Am: Oh, I assume you're referring to the Bryant Town Carnival? M-Cn: That's correct. According to our records, you've agreed to set up game booths at the carnival. Would you be able to work at the ticket booth for a few hours once the event begins as well? The person who was assigned that responsibility has fallen ill, so we need someone to fill in for her. W-Am: Yes, of course. However, I can only stay until about 5:00 p.m. as I have another engagement later in the day.

M-Cn: Maybe we could hang this painting behind our spa's reception desk. I like the relaxing beach scene. M-Cn: Yeah, plus the blue colors match the spa's interior. But first, we should ask Monica's opinion. Hey Monica, how about buying this painting for our lobby? W-Am: Don't we have something like that near the entrance? M-Cn: You mean the one with the sailboats? I hadn't thought of that. We wouldn't want two related works close together. W-Am: What about buying artwork from a website instead of at a gallery? There will be more choices online. M-Cn: Oh, have you two heard of crafty.com? It sells reasonably priced works from less popular artists. W-Am: We can browse that site when we return from our lunch break.

M-Cn: It's Liam O'Reilly from the Cypress Mall branch. I'm assisting a customer who is interested in renting a van that can seat a minimum of eight people. Do you happen to have any available? W-Am: Unfortunately, the two we have on our lot are reserved for use later today. Let me check the database. Um, yes, it appears we have three that would be appropriate. Why don't I ask a staff member to drive one to your location right away? It shouldn't take more than 15 minutes or so. M-Cn: That's great. I'm sure the customer won't mind waiting. Please tell the employee to inform me upon reaching the facility. Thanks.

M-Cn: Excuse me, where is the observation deck for the harbor located? W-Br: Just walk towards Starfish Beach after you exit this visitor center. The deck is on the corner. Ah, and it's fortunate you came today. The boardwalk will be filled with people tomorrow because of a kite flying competition. M-Cn: Good to know. By the way, I'll be able to see Dune Island from the deck, right? W-Br: Yes. New viewing machines were just installed there and the weather is clear today. M-Cn: Great. Also, I'm curious how much the parking fee for the nearby lot is. W-Br: The regular price is $20 per day, but local residents only pay $15 because they get a 25% discount.

W-Am: Did you see this section of the carpet? There's a rather large stain here. M-Au: Oh, what a mess. Maybe something was spilled during the year-end party that occurred earlier this afternoon. I'm worried because our clients from Downview Legal Associates are arriving for a meeting at 3:00 p.m. W-Am: We should use conference room D instead, seeing as it's unoccupied right now. M-Au: Oh, right. I'll gather up our presentation handouts and bring them there. While I do that, please call the building maintenance team. They should deal with the stain in conference room C as soon as possible, since Janice Chung will conduct an interview there later this afternoon.

W-Am: Good morning, Miss Chancey. I work at Source Incorporated, and I'm calling to inform you about a credit card that our company just released called the Gold Rewards card. It offers a unique benefits package that caters to the spending habits of each customer. These benefits include 10% off at 20 major retail chains. Moreover, points accumulated through card purchases may be transferred to any of the five most popular frequent flyer programs. If you want to take advantage of this amazing opportunity, just fill out an application form at www.sourceinc.com.

W-Br: Please join me in welcoming Jason Chow to the stage as he is being given the Employee of the Year award. Mr. Chow was named one of our marketing firm's supervisors late last year, and he's really shown his worth to the company since then. He was responsible for all of the marketing activities we implemented for Tiger Cars, including some of our most successful magazine advertisements to date. Because of that campaign, we have attracted several new clients and have consequently seen our profits rise in recent months. So let's give a big round of applause for Mr. Chow.

M-Au: Homestead Bookstore is excited to announce that the final installment in author Mary Ann Lane's popular series of fantasy novels, Wicked Witches, will be released on November 10th. To celebrate, our Westport branch will give away tickets to the book signing event being held there on November 30th. These will be given to the first 300 customers who purchase her novel at that branch. If you are interested in this opportunity, be sure to get there early on the 10th. Ms. Lane has a lot of fans who will be thrilled about this chance to meet her. For more information regarding this and other Homestead offers, I recommend downloading our mobile application.

W-Am: I have some important news. This spring, our firm will be partnering with a watch design company, Elevated Time. We've been commissioned to produce the company's newest line of high-end watches. Elevated Time sells its watches in over 50 countries, so this will be our most profitable contract yet. It is a major opportunity for a growing firm like ours, and we need to do our best to make sure things go well. If the company is pleased with our final products, I'm quite positive that we'll be able to secure future work with them.

M-Cn: I want to begin by saying it's been an honor to spend the final two decades of my career working in the public sector here at the State Consumer Protection Agency. As a legal department administrator, I oversaw the creation of numerous laws that help protect the rights and safety of consumers. That's something I'm very proud of, and I'll always cherish my time here. Although I look forward to spending more time with my family, I will miss working with such a skilled group of people. Finally, let me express my gratitude to all of you for organizing this party. I had no idea that one was being planned. Thank you.

W-Br: Thank you for volunteering at our community center's basketball tournament. I have a few last-minute things to discuss with you before the event begins. First of all, two volunteers should stay outside this gymnasium to direct traffic. While you are doing this, please make sure that visitors do not park near the rear entrance. That area must be kept clear for emergency vehicles. Once the event is over, all of you should help the janitorial staff by picking up any garbage left by attendees. Okay, that's it for now. I'll let you know if I need your assistance with anything else.

M-Au: Welcome to this week in Brooklyn on Central Radio 96.1 FM. On Tuesday, the latest phase of a redevelopment project in the Bentham neighborhood was completed. Over the last three months, an old toy factory has been renovated to provide studios for artists. The space is going to open its doors this Friday with painters, writers, musicians, and other artists holding a party for the grand opening event. The developer of the site, who also converted the old Wentworth warehouse into apartments, hopes that it will serve to further improve the area. Now, we'll have a brief talk with one of the construction company's board members, Stephen Guttering.

W-Br: Kenny, it's Nina Emerson. I'm calling about our conversation yesterday afternoon concerning the firm's incoming recruits. You asked if I'd be willing to take charge of their orientation session next Friday. I just remembered that I'll be out of town for a convention that day, so I can't assist you. However, Victoria Styles has directed training workshops in the past, and she's offered to help out. I suggest talking with her in person sometime today. Just note that her office is no longer on the third floor. She moved to the top floor when she transferred to another department. As for your comments about the Greenway project, we'll have to discuss that when I get back.

W-Am: May I have your attention please. Passengers bound for Hartsfield may begin boarding the vessel at 3:10 p.m. For those of you traveling to Bridgeport, there will be a delay unfortunately. Your ship is expected to arrive here at 3:30, which means that you won't be able to board until 4:00. A car that was disembarking at the last stop had some engine trouble, and a tow truck had to be called to remove it from the ship. We apologize for the inconvenience. Finally, the ferry for Harrisburg will depart on schedule at 4:10. Please remember to review the pamphlet with information about emergency procedures after you board the vessel. You will find it on your seat. Thank you.

M-Cn: First of all, thank you for developing the new solar panel so quickly. I didn't expect the prototype to be ready for another two weeks, and it looks like this panel will be a significant improvement over our existing model. Assuming it functions as expected, we should see a 15% increase in power generation. Which brings me to the next stage of the project. The initial test of the panel will be conducted next week. The forecast calls for rain on Monday, and Tuesday is a national holiday, so we'll do it on the next clear day. My assistant, Charlotte Cruz, confirmed with the maintenance department this morning that we'll be able to gain access to the building's roof to set up our equipment. Any questions?

From	Tropical Tours <customersupport@tropicaltours.com>
Date	March 1
Subject	Notice regarding Southeast Asia tour

Dear Mr. Fletcher,

We regret to inform you that Tropical Tours has been forced to call off the Southeast Asia tour you booked from March 3 through March 10. You may have seen on the news that a severe storm hit the region yesterday and has caused serious damage. The airports you were scheduled to use in Jakarta, Singapore, and Kuala Lumpur remain closed to commercial planes for the time being. Airport officials believe it will be four days until air traffic will return to normal. And as the storm travels, other tour destinations may be affected as well.

Everything Video Opens Store

By Kelly Warren

Everything Video, a pioneer in the used electronics marketplace, recently opened its fourth store, this time in San Diego. With popular branches in Anaheim, Los Angeles, and San Bernardino, the chain’s new store, located in the Seaside Mall, is its largest location yet. The space boasts an incredible variety of thousands of games for multiple platforms that date back to the 1980s. There is also a smaller section of game consoles, handheld players, and an assortment of other vintage video game devices. Used movies on videotape or DVD are also available.

Kendra Brown, founder of Everything Video, says, “A lot of people miss owning physical objects.” She explained that the shift in recent years to playing games and watching movies online has indirectly created a demand for physical products. “Often, our customers buy these items for sentimental reasons.”

Not only can customers do some shopping, but Everything Video buys stock as well. If you have games, movies, or devices they’re interested in, staff offer cash payments or store credit to use at any of their locations in exchange for them.

According to branch manager Dane Cruz, as an introductory special, shoppers who buy three games or more will receive a 20 percent discount off their total purchase amount. The offer is valid until August 1 and is only available at the San Diego branch.

questions.stem: Where will Ms. Ming most likely go first upon arrival?
questions.explanation: Đáp án C. Người đàn ông hỏi "Also, could she be taken to the Palm Hotel before being brought to our office?". Ông ấy muốn khách hàng đến khách sạn Palm trước khi đến văn phòng, nên địa điểm đầu tiên cô ấy đến là khách sạn.

questions.stem: What does the woman say she will do?
questions.explanation: Đáp án A. Người phụ nữ nói "I'll add the pickup to our schedule and one of our employees will be at the airport in the morning to get her.". Việc thêm chuyến đón khách vào lịch trình của công ty tương đương với việc cập nhật thời gian biểu, nên đáp án A là lựa chọn đúng.

questions.stem: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.explanation: Đáp án C. "I'd like you to deliver food and drinks to the eighth floor conference room for approximately 50 people on that day." Người phụ nữ đang yêu cầu nhà hàng giao đồ ăn và thức uống cho một bữa tiệc trưa tại phòng họp, đây chính là dịch vụ phục vụ ăn uống (catering). Do đó, chủ đề chính của cuộc hội thoại là về việc đặt dịch vụ ăn uống cho sự kiện.

questions.stem: What does the woman mention about the menu?

options.text: It indicates discounts for group orders.

questions.explanation: Đáp án A. "I noticed on your online menu that you have vegetarian sandwiches." Người phụ nữ đề cập rằng cô ấy đã thấy món bánh mì chay trên thực đơn trực tuyến của nhà hàng. Vì vậy, cô ấy yêu cầu đặt 10 phần bánh mì loại này.

questions.stem: What does the woman ask the man about?
questions.explanation: Đáp án D. "Also, do you offer drinks without any sugar?" Sau khi đặt món ăn, người phụ nữ hỏi thêm liệu nhà hàng có cung cấp các loại đồ uống không đường hay không. Câu hỏi này liên quan trực tiếp đến các lựa chọn đồ uống (beverage options).

questions.stem: Who most likely is the woman?
questions.explanation: Đáp án C. "Please wait while I pull up your records. Also, did you by chance bring your health insurance card today? If so, please place it on the counter." Người phụ nữ yêu cầu bệnh nhân chờ để kiểm tra hồ sơ và đặt thẻ bảo hiểm lên quầy, đây là công việc đặc trưng của nhân viên lễ tân tại phòng khám. Vì vậy, cô ấy là lễ tân.

questions.stem: What does the woman ask for?
questions.explanation: Đáp án A. "Also, did you by chance bring your health insurance card today?" Người phụ nữ hỏi trực tiếp ông Peters rằng liệu ông có mang theo thẻ bảo hiểm y tế hôm nay không. Do đó, cô ấy đang yêu cầu thẻ bảo hiểm.

questions.stem: According to the woman, what is a benefit of the new system?
questions.explanation: Đáp án C. "All the state hospitals recently adopted a new record sharing system that will keep patients like you from having to register personal information at each facility." Người phụ nữ giải thích hệ thống mới giúp chia sẻ hồ sơ giữa các bệnh viện, giúp bệnh nhân không phải đăng ký lại thông tin cá nhân. Điều này tương ứng với việc thông tin được chia sẻ.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the call?
questions.explanation: Đáp án D. "Would you be willing to sell them at my store on a commission basis?" Người đàn ông hỏi liệu người phụ nữ có muốn bán khung ảnh tại cửa hàng của ông ấy theo hình thức ký gửi hay không. Đây chính là lời đề nghị hợp tác kinh doanh.

questions.stem: What does the woman offer to do?
questions.explanation: Đáp án A. "Why don't I bring some samples to your store later this week?" Người phụ nữ đề nghị mang các mẫu sản phẩm đến cửa hàng của người đàn ông vào cuối tuần này. Việc mang mẫu đến cửa hàng đồng nghĩa với việc bà ấy sẽ ghé thăm cửa hàng đó.

questions.stem: What does the man ask about?
questions.explanation: Đáp án A. "Um, how many frames can you produce each month?" Người đàn ông hỏi về số lượng khung ảnh mà người phụ nữ có thể làm ra mỗi tháng. Đây chính là câu hỏi về năng lực sản xuất của người phụ nữ.

questions.stem: According to the woman, what does the supervisor want to do?
questions.explanation: Đáp án C. "Our supervisor wants to review them in our meeting at 4 p.m." Người phụ nữ nhắc đến việc người giám sát muốn xem xét các bản thiết kế (blueprints). Cụm từ "review" có nghĩa là xem xét, kiểm tra, đồng nghĩa với "look over" trong đáp án C.

questions.stem: What problem does the man mention?

options.text: A task is taking too long.
A new hire is going to be late.
A building has been closed down.
A customer has made a complaint.

questions.explanation: Đáp án A. "It's been taking me longer than anticipated." Người đàn ông giải thích rằng công việc làm slide thuyết trình đang tốn nhiều thời gian hơn dự kiến. Điều này cho thấy vấn đề là công việc đang kéo dài quá lâu, khớp với đáp án A.

questions.stem: Why does the man say, ''I'll e-mail you the presentation materials in a minute''?

options.text: To agree to take on an assignment
To show interest in a project
To accept an offer of help
To express concern about a situation

questions.explanation: Đáp án C. "I'll email you the presentation materials in a minute." Trước đó người phụ nữ đã đề nghị giúp đỡ hoàn thành slide, và người đàn ông nói câu này để gửi tài liệu cho cô ấy. Đây là hành động chấp nhận lời đề nghị giúp đỡ, nên đáp án C là chính xác.

questions.stem: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.explanation: Đáp án D. Người đàn ông hỏi "will Hall A in our museum have enough room for the Egyptian art exhibition?" (Phòng A trong bảo tàng của chúng ta có đủ chỗ cho triển lãm nghệ thuật Ai Cập không?). Cả đoạn hội thoại xoay quanh việc chuẩn bị cho triển lãm này, nên đáp án là D.

questions.stem: What does Brian imply about Hall C?

It will be used for a convention.

(Chỉ có hai tá thôi, nhưng tất cả đều lớn, vì vậy chúng ta cần một không gian rộng. Tôi đề xuất phòng C thay thế). Việc đề xuất phòng C thay vì phòng A vì cần không gian lớn hơn ngụ ý phòng C lớn hơn phòng A. Đáp án đúng là C.

questions.stem: Why is the woman concerned?

options.text: A display has too few items.
A space has to be enlarged.

questions.explanation: Đáp án D. Người phụ nữ nói "Um, I'm a little worried since that only gives us three days to set up the necessary pieces." (Ừm, tôi hơi lo lắng vì điều đó chỉ cho chúng ta ba ngày để sắp xếp các tác phẩm cần thiết). Việc chỉ có 3 ngày để chuẩn bị cho thấy lịch trình rất gấp rút. Đáp án đúng là D.

questions.explanation: Đáp án A. "I was hoping to reach Miss Brenda Ling in regard to the advanced accounting course she completed last week." questions.stem: Why does the woman say, ''Don't we have something like that near the entrance?''
questions.explanation: Đáp án D. "We wouldn't want two related works close together." Khi người nam gợi ý mua bức tranh, người nữ đã phản đối bằng cách nhắc đến việc họ đã có một bức tương tự ở lối vào. Cô ấy không muốn hai tác phẩm giống nhau đặt gần nhau nên đây là cách từ chối khéo léo.

questions.stem: What does the woman suggest?
questions.explanation: Đáp án A. "What about buying artwork from a website instead of at a gallery?" Người nữ đưa ra gợi ý thay thế là mua tác phẩm nghệ thuật từ một trang web thay vì ở phòng trưng bày. Cô ấy cho rằng mua online sẽ có nhiều sự lựa chọn hơn.

questions.explanation: Đáp án B. "I'm assisting a customer who is interested in renting a van that can seat a minimum of eight people." Người đàn ông đề cập đến việc hỗ trợ khách hàng muốn thuê một chiếc xe van. Vì họ đang thảo luận về việc thuê xe, nên công ty này là một đại lý cho thuê xe.

questions.stem: What does the woman propose?

Meeting a customer at a main office

questions.explanation: Đáp án A. "Why don't I ask a staff member to drive one to your location right away?" Người phụ nữ đề nghị cử nhân viên lái xe đến địa điểm của người đàn ông ngay lập tức. Hành động lái xe đến địa điểm của khách hàng chính là việc giao xe (delivery).

questions.stem: What does the man request?
questions.explanation: Đáp án A. "Please tell the employee to inform me upon reaching the facility." Người đàn ông yêu cầu nhân viên thông báo cho anh ấy khi họ đến nơi. Cụm từ "inform me" (thông báo cho tôi) tương ứng với việc yêu cầu một thông báo khi nhân viên đến nơi.

questions.stem: Look at the graphic. Where is the observation deck located?
questions.explanation: Đáp án B. Dựa vào hình ảnh (graphic) trong bài thi, đài quan sát nằm tại Coastal Rest Stop. Người phụ nữ chỉ dẫn: "Just walk towards Starfish Beach after you exit this visitor center. The deck is on the corner." Câu này hướng dẫn cách đi đến đài quan sát, và thông tin địa điểm cụ thể nằm ở hình ảnh.

questions.stem: What does the woman say about the boardwalk?

questions.explanation: Đáp án A. Người phụ nữ nói: "The boardwalk will be filled with people tomorrow because of a kite flying competition." Câu này có nghĩa là lối đi bộ sẽ chật kín người vào ngày mai do có cuộc thi thả diều, đồng nghĩa với việc nơi đó sẽ rất đông đúc.

questions.stem: How much of a parking fee discount is offered to local residents?
questions.explanation: Đáp án D. Người phụ nữ giải thích: "local residents only pay $15 because they get a 25% discount." Câu này có nghĩa là cư dân địa phương chỉ phải trả 15 đô la vì họ được hưởng mức giảm giá 25%.

questions.explanation: Đáp án B. "Did you see this section of the carpet? There's a rather large stain here." Người phụ nữ hỏi người đàn ông có thấy vết bẩn lớn trên thảm không. "Stain" (vết bẩn) đồng nghĩa với "mark" (vết) và "carpet" (thảm) đồng nghĩa với "rug" trong đáp án.

questions.stem: Look at the graphic. Who booked the room for a client meeting?
questions.explanation: Đáp án C. "I'm worried because our clients from Downview Legal Associates are arriving for a meeting at 3:00 p.m." Dựa vào thông tin trong hình ảnh (graphic) đi kèm đề thi, Brad Derby là người đã đặt phòng cho cuộc họp với khách hàng từ Downview Legal Associates vào lúc 3 giờ chiều.

questions.stem: What will the man probably do next?
questions.explanation: Đáp án A. "I'll gather up our presentation handouts and bring them there." Người đàn ông nói anh ấy sẽ đi thu gom các tài liệu thuyết trình để mang sang phòng họp mới. Hành động này đồng nghĩa với việc "Collect some documents" (thu thập tài liệu).

questions.stem: Where does the speaker most likely work?
questions.explanation: Đáp án A. "I work at Source Incorporated, and I'm calling to inform you about a credit card that our company just released called the Gold Rewards card."
